hierarchy.notes: An adaptive GitHub-first identity surface: browser OAuth when configured, proven GitHub CLI verification otherwise, with one immutable subject and identity proof kept separate from usage truth.

forbidden_imports: blue-check state derived from session metadata alone

classification.notes: The browser briefly receives a Supabase access token and OAuth provider token. The provider token is sent once to the trusted link endpoint and is never persisted by this module.

ssa_v2.notes: Session derivation, provider availability, adaptive account interaction, global status, and server status lookup are separated into focused files; the largest source file is 240 lines.

ssi.notes: The console selects between the existing OAuth and GitHub CLI proof channels while both resolve to the same immutable GitHub subject and existing link contracts.

sstf.notes: Nineteen focused identity contracts and the full 611-test suite cover sanitization, redirect safety, status authorization, one-time linking, local sign-out, adaptive CLI fallback, responsive layout, and motion safety.

spe.notes: Provider settings are fetched once, auth state is subscription-driven, and link status is a bounded same-origin request.

srs.notes: Signed-out, checking, OAuth-ready, CLI-ready, unavailable, session-only, linked, migration, copy-success, and copy-failure states are visible; a missing provider never leaves the primary action disabled.

ssra.notes: Exact deploy 6a564ba0545612fcf12c76f5 from d896cf3 passed the provider-disabled CLI action, clipboard feedback, a second real GitHub CLI identity exchange, all network requests, zero console errors, 390x844 mobile and 3840x2160 fullscreen proof, and Lighthouse 100 in all four reported categories. Browser OAuth remains visibly unavailable until its dedicated GitHub app is configured.

sas.notes: Account, status, and contract surfaces have explicit leases and an owned-path manifest; unrelated logo work remains outside this brick.

sva.notes: The server validates bearer sessions, returns only sanitized identity fields, and neither adaptive channel persists raw GitHub credentials or infers a blue check from session metadata.

srls.notes: The status endpoint validates the user with Supabase Auth before a service-role identity lookup; anonymous status reads fail closed.

sev.notes: Public Supabase configuration is guarded client-side, the service-role key is secret-scoped in Netlify, and live invalid-token/session probes fail without returning credentials.

ssc.notes: The slice adds no dependency and reuses the existing Next, React, Supabase, and telemetry stack.

sai.notes: Intent, owned files, current-tree gates, exact deploy, real GitHub CLI exchange, provider blocker, and identity/usage boundary are captured in the Gen3 receipt and this manifest.

negative_tests: unlinked session returns no identity row

code_budget.notes: The implementation is split across the route, pure session helper, global control, server status endpoint, styles, and focused contracts.

verification.command: focused auth tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm build + pnpm --dir packages/web build
verification.notes: 11 focused auth tests, 15 control-plane tests, 600 package tests, strict telemetry with zero violations, typecheck, root build, Next production build, and high-severity dependency audit pass. Production deploy 6a561ed964e7fc3860233003 is live at vibeusage.c0vibe.app; CLI start returns 200, poll remains pending without a token, invalid GitHub verification and browser sessions return 401 without credentials, mobile/desktop/4K interaction proofs pass without horizontal overflow, and Lighthouse scores 100/100/100/100.

verification.command: 19 focused identity tests + pnpm test + pnpm typecheck + pnpm telemetry:audit:strict + pnpm audit --audit-level high + pnpm sma:gen3:check + production build/deploy + real CLI/browser proof
verification.notes: 611 tests and every gate passed. Exact deploy 6a564ba0545612fcf12c76f5 exposes an enabled CLI primary action when OAuth is disabled, copy feedback succeeds, the post-deploy GitHub CLI identity exchange succeeds without browser approval or usage movement, mobile/4K have no overflow, and Lighthouse reports four 100 scores.

adaptation_points: Create a dedicated GitHub OAuth app for the target Supabase callback.
Configure the GitHub provider and production redirect allowlist.
Keep the verified GitHub CLI channel active until browser OAuth is proven live.
Retain the immutable GitHub subject as the account migration anchor.
install_steps: Copy the account, global control, browser auth, and status surfaces.
Connect the existing identity-link endpoint and Supabase environment.
Configure a dedicated OAuth provider, then rerun live auth proof.
known_traps: Do not reuse another product's OAuth credentials or callback.
Do not store provider tokens or service-role credentials in the browser.
Do not use identity verification as proof of usage volume or leaderboard tier.
